ideas.idea: Add address, opening hours, phone and pre-order method to the visible page text
ideas.why: The home page mentions pre-order and collection but gives no address, hours or contact, so adding them helps visitors and machines.

ideas.idea: Add Bakery/LocalBusiness JSON-LD once the details are on the page
ideas.why: Accurate, but the deliberate choices say JSON-LD isn't required, and the report frames it as optional labelling.

ideas.idea: List the loaves (or a page per loaf) to back up the 'over twenty loaves' claim
ideas.why: breads.html says over twenty loaves but names only two, so a list gives readers and machines the actual content.

ideas.idea: Add booking link/form, price, date, length and group size to the classes page
ideas.why: classes.html says to book early but offers no way to book and no price, date or size details.
Accurate, since the entries have no lastmod, but it has a small effect on a three-URL site.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image)
ideas.why: Accurate, but it applies to almost any site and affects only how shared links look.

ideas.idea: Put more allergen detail in normal page text, outside data-nosnippet
ideas.why: It is specific to breads.html, whose only allergen text is 'Contains gluten. Ask us about allergens.', and it leaves the deliberate nosnippet intact.
